data-audit v1.0.0

- Initial release providing complete local data directory audit capabilities.
- Generate SHA256-based directory snapshots for data integrity.
- Compare snapshots to detect and report added, deleted, or modified files.
- Log and query data operation history for compliance traceability.
- Run automated health checks of directories (empty files/dirs, unreadable files).
- Export audit, comparison, and validation reports in JSON format.
- All features run locally with no network requests; no external dependencies beyond Python standard library.

data-audit v1.0.0

- 首发版本，实现对数据目录的SHA256快照生成
- 支持快照间文件变动（新增/删除/修改）比对
- 记录操作日志并生成审计报告，便于数据合规与追踪
- 完全本地运行，安全性高，不产生网络请求
